axes.label: Friendly Bleed, Curse, or Disease removal

notes: Cauterizing Flame removes Regurgitate's Disease but not the Magic Paralyzing Shots effect; Overawe removes Ravenous Claws' Enrage.
Tail Swipe, Wing Buffet, and Sleep Walk are control stops rather than Quell-style school lockouts.
The source fragment naming Muro'jin, Nekraxx, Flanking Spear, Infected Pinions, and Blood Frenzy belongs to Maisara Caverns; WHELP rejects it as Blinding Vale evidence.
Zephyr is reserved for area-damage events and does not reduce arbitrary single-target damage.
Cauterizing Flame provides the guide's Curse removal while Overawe has no sourced Enrage target here.
Use Quell for priority casts; Sleep Walk remains a breakable control stop, not an interrupt replacement on immune targets.
Expunge removes Heartstop Poison, Cauterizing Flame removes Curse of Doom, and Overawe can recover a missed Fel Rage interrupt by removing its Enrage.
The guide's Spectral Axethrower and Phantasmal Mystic examples belong to Windrunner Spire and are rejected as Murder Row evidence.
Quell interrupts Violent Sand, Expunge removes Corrosive Essence, and Overawe removes Bolster; these are canonical Voidscar mechanics.
Vile Lasher, Territorial Eagle, Alpha Eagle, and Algeth'ar Echoknight belong to Algeth'ar Academy and are rejected as Voidscar evidence.
Expunge handles Poison effects while Quell covers Addle Mind and other priority casts; Cauterizing Flame is the long-cooldown multi-domain fallback.
Misplaced mechanics from unrelated dungeons on the current guide page are intentionally excluded.
Cauterizing Flame and Expunge cover eligible player debuffs, while Quell remains the primary answer to priority casts.
Do not remove Ancestral Fury merely because Overawe can Soothe it: the effect also increases damage taken. Sleep Walk has limited value against the dungeon's Undead population.
The current guide section contains mechanics from an unrelated dungeon, so WHELP records no unsupported cleanse or Soothe target here.
Quell, susceptibility-dependent stops, Zephyr, and movement support retain general dungeon value.

recommendations: Quell handles a separated orb; Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet provide clustered stops without becoming school interrupts.
No dedicated utility swap is sourced; prioritize damage on the emissary.
Hover supplies personal mobility, while Time Spiral, Rescue, or Spatial Paradox can support partners depending on the selected choice node.
Expunge or Cauterizing Flame removes eligible shields; Rescue helps an ally reach their partner but is not a dispel.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Preheat's Patch 12.1.0 Devastation dungeon and affix guidance, cross-checked against WHELP's canonical dungeon spell catalog.
